name: meetnote
description: MeetNote Summaries — AI Meeting Assistant by TechAbhee

scripts.sign:mac: xattr -cr dist/mac-arm64/MeetNote.app && codesign --force --sign - --entitlements entitlements.mac.plist --timestamp=none dist/mac-arm64/MeetNote.app/Contents/Resources/swift-bridge/swift-capture-bridge && codesign --force --sign - --entitlements entitlements.mac.plist --timestamp=none --deep dist/mac-arm64/MeetNote.app && codesign --verify --strict dist/mac-arm64/MeetNote.app && echo SIGNED $(codesign -dvvv dist/mac-arm64/MeetNote.app 2>&1 | grep '^CDHash=')
scripts.build:all: npm run build:mac && npm run build:win
scripts.install:mac: rm -rf /Applications/MeetNote.app && cp -Rp dist/mac-arm64/MeetNote.app /Applications/MeetNote.app && xattr -cr /Applications/MeetNote.app && codesign --verify --strict /Applications/MeetNote.app && open /Applications/MeetNote.app && echo INSTALLED $(codesign -dvvv /Applications/MeetNote.app 2>&1 | grep '^CDHash=')

author: TechAbhee

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MeetNote needs microphone access to record your voice in meetings.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: MeetNote needs Screen Recording access to capture system audio from meeting apps.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: MeetNote needs audio capture access to record and transcribe meetings.
